cases.title: cEMV — tap enablement by route, location and fare
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the PV is in a context where the route attribute, location and fare checks all pass
-> **THEN** cEMV taps are enabled
**AND** a tap is accepted
**WHEN** any of the route, location or fare checks fail
-> **THEN** cEMV taps are disabled in that context and no cEMV tap is taken
**WHEN** you check the back office for the accepted tap
-> **THEN** the tap appears in the CloudFare activity log and MERIT
**WHEN** the Glider Tap On Only Zone TMS parameter is configured correctly and matches the device's boarding location

-> **THEN** the immediate re-tap is declined as Passback, not charged as a second fare
**AND** the day's taps are aggregated under the applicable capping rule
**WHEN** you check the back office for the journeys
-> **THEN** the flat-fare journey appears in the CloudFare activity log and MERIT

**AND** no successful validation is recorded

cases.title: Multiple-Use Barcode — a valid barcode shows the green success result
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the passenger presents the valid multiple-use barcode
-> **THEN** the PV displays a green-tick success result
**AND** a success audio tone is played

cases.title: Multiple-Use Barcode — an invalid barcode shows the red failure result
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the passenger presents the expired multiple-use barcode
-> **THEN** the PV displays a red-cross failure result
**AND** the screen shows the failure reason

cases.title: Pilot List — an enrolled FEIG token validates and audits normally
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the passenger taps the enrolled card
-> **THEN** the PV proceeds down the normal cEMV success flow
**AND** an ABT audit record is generated for the tap

cases.title: Pilot List — a non-enrolled token is rejected with no audit event
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the passenger taps the non-enrolled card
-> **THEN** the PV shows the standard rejection screen
**AND** no ABT audit event is generated for the tap

cases.title: Pilot Registration — the registration file uploads once per day at End-of-Day
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the configured End-of-Day time is reached
-> **THEN** the registration file is uploaded as a zip to CloudFare Device Logging
**AND** the file is not uploaded in real time as tokens are captured

cases.title: NIR Audit — a rail TOTO tap posts a conformant PV audit record
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the tap posts its ABT audit record to CloudFare
-> **THEN** the record uses the TotoTap/Location structure with a single tap location
**AND** the product id is 6000
**AND** the paymentType is "ABT"
**AND** the revenue is 0

cases.title: Legacy Transfer — decided by the product Transfer Time, not a route property
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the card is re-presented inside the transfer window
-> **THEN** the PV records a transfer with no journey deducted
**AND** a WTS SmartTransfer transaction is audited

cases.title: Legacy Transfer — re-validation outside the product Transfer Time counts as a journey
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the card is re-presented outside the transfer window
-> **THEN** the PV deducts a journey
**AND** a WTS SmartUse transaction is audited

cases.title: Power — recovers to service with transactions intact
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** power is interrupted
-> **THEN** the PV shuts down safely without corrupting the stored transactions
**WHEN** power is restored
-> **THEN** the PV restarts and returns to service
**AND** the stored transactions are intact and still upload to the back office

cases.title: PV to BOS — software and FEIG update via CloudFare TMS
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the update is distributed to the PV
-> **THEN** the PV applies the update
**AND** the new version is reported to the back office
**WHEN** you check the back office
-> **THEN** the new version is visible in CloudFare

cases.title: PV to BOS — Deny and BIN list download
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the PV downloads the updated lists
-> **THEN** the lists are applied to the PV FEIG for cEMV validation
**WHEN** you check the back office
-> **THEN** the list download is recorded in CloudFare

cases.title: PV to BOS — transaction upload
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the PV communicates with the back office
-> **THEN** the transactions are uploaded to the back office
**WHEN** you check the back office
-> **THEN** the uploaded transactions appear in the CloudFare activity log

cases.title: Clock — GMT/BST change carries into time-based validation
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the daylight saving change occurs
-> **THEN** the PV clock adjusts to the new time
**WHEN** you present the time-limited card after the change
-> **THEN** time-based validation uses the new (adjusted) time

cases.title: PV to BOS — MERIT heartbeat
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the configured 24-hour period elapses
-> **THEN** a MERIT heartbeat transaction is sent to the back office
**WHEN** the PV enters an in-service state by any means — an automatic or manual reboot (including a CloudFare remote reboot), a technician signing out, or returning from a temporary automatic out-of-service state
-> **THEN** a MERIT heartbeat transaction is sent, not only after a technician sign-out (pins TIBU-28386)

cases.title: PV — scheduled reboot
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the configured reboot time is reached
-> **THEN** the device reboots
**AND** the PV returns to service after the reboot
**WHEN** you check the back office
-> **THEN** the scheduled reboot is recorded in CloudFare

cases.title: PV to BOS — configuration and topology distribution
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the PV downloads a configuration or topology update for immediate activation
-> **THEN** the update is applied
**WHEN** the update has a future activation date
-> **THEN** it is stored and activated on that date
**WHEN** a corrupt configuration file is downloaded
-> **THEN** it is rejected
**AND** the current configuration is retained

cases.title: PV — scheduled maintenance
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the maintenance window is reached while the PV is idle
-> **THEN** the scheduled maintenance is performed
**WHEN** the PV comes out of the suspended state
-> **THEN** the PV resumes to service

cases.title: PV — validation and barcode performance timings
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** you present a smartcard for validation
-> **THEN** the validation completes within the acceptable timing
**WHEN** you validate barcodes at throughput
-> **THEN** each barcode reads within the acceptable timing and throughput

cases.title: PV — stability and recovery
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the device fails to boot
-> **THEN** the recovery mechanism restarts it to a working state
**WHEN** the device would otherwise freeze on the white startup screen, or go black-screen mid-update after a reboot
-> **THEN** it recovers to service without manual intervention (pins TIBU-25842 and TIBU-28240)
**WHEN** the PV runs over an extended period
-> **THEN** the transaction service stays responsive
**AND** the PV continues to download and apply new distributions
**AND** deployments via TMS succeed

cases.title: PV — asset and version reporting
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** you view the software version page
-> **THEN** the Application version is displayed
**AND** the PCA application version is displayed
**WHEN** the PV reports to CloudFare
-> **THEN** the SIM ID is sent to CloudFare and visible in Asset Manager
**AND** the FEIG Device ID is displayed in Asset Manager associated assets
**WHEN** the FEIG versions are viewed in CloudFare Asset Manager for the device
-> **THEN** only one set of FEIG versions is shown, not duplicated (pins TIBU-26531)

cases.title: PV to BOS — Device Log Manager retrieves device logs on request
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** you select the PV's Device Type and Device ID in Device Log Manager and request its logs (Get Files, with the to-date set to cover today)
-> **THEN** the requested logs become available to download from Device Log Manager after a short wait (refresh after a few minutes)

cases.title: Comms Lock — a sustained loss of both Ethernet and cellular drives the PV out of service
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the loss of both channels is sustained beyond the device's offline tolerance
-> **THEN** the PV enters a communication-locked, out-of-service state
**AND** the PV stops accepting taps

cases.title: Comms Recovery — transactions queued during an outage are delivered on restore
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the Translink-network connection is restored
-> **THEN** the queued transactions are delivered to the back office
**AND** no queued transaction is lost

cases.title: Comms Failover — Ethernet loss fails the PV over to cellular
cases.custom_steps:
**WHEN** the Ethernet connection is disconnected
-> **THEN** a PrimaryCommsChannelFailed (812) set event is raised in the CloudFare Activity Log
**AND** the PV fails over to the cellular connection
**WHEN** the operator presents the smartcard to the PV while it is running on cellular
-> **THEN** the 'Validation Success' screen is displayed
**AND** the transaction is identifiable in the back office (CloudFare, SmarTrack, MERIT)
**WHEN** the Ethernet connection is reconnected
-> **THEN** a PrimaryCommsChannelFailed (812) clear event is raised in the CloudFare Activity Log
**AND** the PV fails back to operating over Ethernet
